E1 integrates fixed-parameter inequalities by Hilbert Plancherel; the final supremum is over separate uniformly bounded norms, not an unproved exchange of a supremum with an integral.

A0 is an actual compact physical scalar test in the prescribed cone. A1 transposes the exact x^-1/2 w^-1/2 input test, uses h>=log(3/2), and bounds the entire omitted cylinder output by the original Banach norm.
T0 orders all choices without circularity and proves the full collar-input family estimate with its stated hypotheses.

X1 evaluates both full convolution tails. X2 retains the Gaussian angular-symbol expansion, circle periodization and every normal side tail, and verifies the exact commuting norm identity. X3 proves the positive-matrix cancellation obstruction explicitly.
